gemini_description.purpose: To define permissible installation zones for a water pump relative to swimming pools, foot-cleaning basins, and surrounding areas to ensure electrical and mechanical safety compliance.
gemini_description.summary: This technical diagram defines three distinct safety zones (Zone 0, Zone 1, and Zone 2) based on horizontal and vertical distances from the pool edge. It highlights Zone 2 as the specific area where the pump may be safely installed.

components.name: Zone 0
components.description: The interior of the pool basin, water storage area, or foot-cleaning basin.

components.name: Zone 1
components.description: The safety perimeter directly surrounding the pool basin, extending 2.0 meters horizontally from the basin edge and 2.5 meters vertically.

components.name: Zone 2
components.description: The shaded safety zone extending an additional 1.5 meters horizontally beyond Zone 1 (up to 3.5 meters total distance from the pool edge) and up to 2.5 meters vertically. This is the highlighted area where the pump may be installed.

components.name: Feet cleaning basin
components.description: A dedicated small basin classified as Zone 0, with its own surrounding Zone 1 and Zone 2 safety perimeters.

procedure: Measure a horizontal distance of 2.0 meters from the pool edges to establish the boundary of Zone 1.
Measure a vertical height of 2.5 meters from the pool floor/ground level to establish the vertical limit of Zone 1.
Measure an additional horizontal distance of 1.5 meters beyond the Zone 1 boundary (reaching a total radial distance of 3.5 meters from the pool edge) to define Zone 2.
Locate and install the water pump within the shaded Zone 2 or in the outdoor area beyond Zone 2, keeping it clear of Zone 0 and Zone 1.

technical_details.detail: r1 = 2.0 m: Horizontal radius defining the outer boundary of Zone 1 from the pool edge.
r2 = 3.5 m: Cumulative horizontal radius defining the outer boundary of Zone 2 from the pool edge.
Vertical height limit for both Zone 1 and Zone 2 is defined as 2.5 m from the walking surface.
Specific clearance/shielding conditions (S1, S2) are shown where structural walls are present near the pool perimeter.

warnings.warning: The pump must not be installed within Zone 0 or Zone 1.
The pump may only be installed within the highlighted/shaded areas (Zone 2) or further away in the designated outdoor area.
